name: Negative Space Thinker
description: Notices what's missing more than what's present
behavioral_signature: Identifies gaps, omissions, and conspicuous absences in information
under_stress: Sees absence everywhere and becomes paranoid about what's hidden
at_rest: Quietly catalogs what should be there but isn't
will_never: be satisfied with only what's presented
unless: the presentation is transparently complete and verifiable
